Hi everyone!
I have a question regarding the criminal record for the partnervisa. I'm german, my husband Israeli. Currently both in Israel. We applied in April for the partnervisa and I had my criminal record translated with an Apostille. Unfortunately the original had no Apostille. So after applying I had to send it back to Germany to get the Apostille. Now I'm waiting since April to get the criminal record back and I can't reach any of the offices. They are not answering. 

My concern is that the criminal record is from January. So when we applied it was two months old. Which is fine. But by now it's already 6 months and I still don't have it back.

I'm wondering which date of sending the criminal record to the immigration counts. The one when we applied or the one I'll hand it in later?

 Has anyone had a similar experience and could tell me if I need a complete new criminal record (also plus the translation again)?

Thanks already!
